title: Chapter XXIV

teacherSummary.text: Walton resumes writing. The ice traps the ship; the crew demands to turn south, and Walton yields. Victor dies. The creature appears over his body, mourns, condemns himself, and vows to destroy himself on a funeral pyre before vanishing into darkness.
